title: 8 Signs You're Chasing a Wife Instead of Chasing God
caption:
Proverbs 18:22 says whoever finds a wife finds a good thing. It's a find, not a hunt, and there's a difference between the two you can feel in your own chest.

A man chasing God gets found by the right woman without ever running the search himself. A man chasing a wife just gets tired.

Chase God first. Let the rest catch up to you.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
